description: Grounded single-question QA acceptance benchmark over shareable synthetic community-project documents.

cases.question: What is the maximum Community Renewal Grant?

expected_facts.description: The maximum grant is GBP 10,000.

cases.question: When do applications for the 2027 community grant close?

expected_facts.description: Applications close at 17:00 on 30 September 2027.

cases.question: What is the minimum age for a general community volunteer?

expected_facts.description: General volunteers must be at least 16.

forbidden_claims: All volunteers may drive project vehicles at age 16.

cases.question: What is the licensed seated capacity of the main community hall?

expected_facts.description: The seated capacity is 180 people.

forbidden_claims: A standing public-event layout is approved.

cases.question: What is the solar array's nameplate rating?

expected_facts.description: The array is rated at 42 kilowatts peak.

cases.notes: An explicitly acceptable corroborating source is available.

cases.question: Which document is the primary source for the emergency contact procedure?

expected_facts.description: The Volunteer Handbook is the primary document.

forbidden_claims: The corpus publishes a private duty-coordinator telephone number.

cases.question: Where are authoritative room capacities recorded?

expected_facts.description: Room capacities are recorded in the Facilities Register.

cases.notes: Document discovery without requiring a generated chunk id.

cases.question: Which document contains the replacement community bus timetable?

expected_facts.description: The Neighbourhood Transport Update 2028 contains it.

forbidden_claims: The 2026 plan is the current replacement timetable.
cases.notes: Document discovery with superseded material in the corpus.

cases.question: Within the funding guide, what is the maximum grant?

expected_facts.description: The maximum is GBP 10,000.

cases.notes: Exercises the existing scalar metadata filter path.

cases.question: Within the facilities register, how many people can use the Cedar meeting room?

expected_facts.description: The Cedar room capacity is 24.

cases.question: Within the volunteer handbook, what age restriction applies to project drivers?

expected_facts.description: Project drivers must be at least 21.

cases.notes: Acceptable alternative is excluded by the deliberate filter.

cases.question: When does the revised community bus service start, and how often will it run?

expected_facts.description: The revised service starts on 3 September 2028.
It runs every 30 minutes on weekdays.

cases.notes: Requires selecting the explicit later update.

cases.question: What is the current scheduled review deadline for the finance policy?

expected_facts.description: The current review deadline is 31 March 2027.

forbidden_claims: The superseded 31 March 2026 date is current.

cases.question: What is the largest combined amount available from the Community Renewal Grant and council match funding?

expected_facts.description: GBP 12,500: GBP 10,000 grant plus GBP 2,500 match funding.

forbidden_claims: Match funding is available without an external award.

cases.question: What is the combined maximum occupancy of the seated main hall and Cedar meeting room?

expected_facts.description: The combined maximum is 204 people.

cases.notes: Combines two sections that may become separate chunks.

cases.question: Can a 19-year-old general volunteer drive a project vehicle? Explain using the age rules.

expected_facts.description: General volunteering is allowed from age 16.
Driving requires age 21, so a 19-year-old cannot drive.

forbidden_claims: A 19-year-old may drive because they may volunteer.

cases.question: How do the North and South garden proposals compare on cost and construction time?

expected_facts.description: South costs GBP 55,000 versus North GBP 48,000, a GBP 7,000 difference.
South is planned for 12 weeks versus North 14 weeks.

cases.question: Compare the stated solar and insulation annual cost savings.

expected_facts.description: Solar is GBP 6,200 and insulation GBP 4,800 annually; solar is GBP 1,400 higher.

forbidden_claims: The audit guarantees future financial returns.
cases.notes: Compares unlike measures without overstating audit scope.

cases.question: How does the 2028 bus frequency differ from the original 2026 pilot?

expected_facts.description: The service changes from every 60 minutes to every 30 minutes.

cases.question: Compare the maximum Community Renewal Grant with the local-business sponsorship cap.

expected_facts.description: The grant maximum is GBP 10,000 and sponsorship cap GBP 4,000; the grant is GBP 6,000 higher.

forbidden_claims: Sponsorship can always count as the applicant's own cash contribution.

cases.question: Who won the community achievement award in 2035?
cases.notes: The synthetic corpus contains no award result or 2035 event.

cases.question: On what date will the community-centre cafe open?
What is the project director's private telephone number?
cases.notes: No private telephone number appears in the shareable corpus.

cases.question: What are the community centre's Saturday opening hours?

expected_facts.description: The notices conflict: 09:00-17:00 versus 10:00-16:00, with no resolved authority.

forbidden_claims: One set of hours is certainly current.
cases.notes: The reviewer expects explicit unresolved uncertainty.

cases.question: What is the total budget for the river path project?

expected_facts.description: The corpus gives unresolved totals of GBP 1.20 million and GBP 1.35 million.

cases.notes: Conflicting quantitative evidence must not be over-resolved.
